The Respondent No. 3, TPDDL has filed its reply vide affidavits dated 13.7.2021 and 30.5.2022 and the Petitioner has filed its rejoinders vide affidavit dated 29.10.2021 and 8.7.2022. In compliance to the direction of the Commission, the Petitioner vide affidavit dated 8.4.2022, has filed the additional information after serving copies to the Respondents. The Petition was again heard on 14.7.2022, through video conferencing and the Commission, after directing the parties to complete their pleadings, reserved its order in the matter.
